data.narrative:
SwarmFarm Robotics is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company that has raised AU$30M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of four same-sector companies at Series B and adjacent Series C stages: Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B), Dexterity ($1.6B), Hadrian ($1.6B), and Nimble Robotics ($1.0B). This subset represents the most directly comparable transactions within a broader universe of nine private robotics firms and one public comparable.

The peer-median method is the sole quantitative approach applicable given available data, yielding an implied valuation of $1.6B. The four-company sample exhibits a range of $1.0B to $1.8B, with Bedrock at the high end and Nimble at the low end. This dispersion reflects stage and operational differences typical within the robotics sector at this development phase.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $1.4B to $1.9B, centered on $1.6B. Primary uncertainties include: limited methodological triangulation (single method applied), stage heterogeneity within the peer set (two Series C firms included), and absence of revenue or margin data to assess relative performance against comparables. A more robust assessment would require additional transaction data or fundamental metrics to validate peer selection and relative positioning.
